responsibility: Implements simple text string I/O on top of StdIO, including line output, plain string output, and interactive line input with basic editing commands such as backspace, delete-word, and delete-line. It owns user-facing character-by-character editing behavior and optional terminal echo policy for string reads, rather than generic stream redirection or file buffering.
same_name_distinction: This .cc file is the implementation of the StrIO interface declared in GStrIO.h: it defines the interactive editing behavior for ReadString, echo/erase helpers, and the actual StdIO-based character output loops. The header only exposes the callable string I/O entry points.
